rooms.name: Split Green Corridor
rooms.instance_premise: A corridor divides around a living green support spine. One branch is soft, warm, and moist; the other is dry shell over cartilage. Spores ride floor flex. A small airway control is mounted in the wall.
rooms.first_visit_description: Chorus, the corridor splits around a green support spine. The left branch stays wet and warm. Footfalls leave slow-closing prints and hold my calf heat after a test step. The right branch is dry shell over exposed cartilage with bright scrape marks that line up where tools were dragged. Green spores drift ankle-high and collect in heel cups from other bodies. When the floor flexes under my boot, the cloud lifts and shows a broken run of wider prints. A thumb-sized airway wheel sits in the wall between the mouths, its tubes running under both branch floors. Brown oil stains ring the wheel from old turns.
